verdict.rationale: Capacities documents its own import flow (Settings > Import Content) with a Notion migration guide that uses a Markdown + CSV export. It also has migration guides for Obsidian (a Markdown vault) and Apple Notes, so Notion and Markdown import are covered first-party. However, the guides ask users to curate structure before export and normalize the vault before import, which signals structure is not carried over automatically, and nothing confirms that links or attachments survive. missing for 10: Evernote import, Roam import, evidence that links and attachments are preserved, structure preserved without manual curation, independent or hands-on corroboration of import quality.
